mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE group_closure AS ( SELECT id AS ancestor_id, id AS descendant_id FROM fcc_agent_group WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND status = 'ENABLED' UNION ALL SELECT closure.ancestor_id, child.id FROM group_closure closure JOIN fcc_agent_group child ON child.parent_id = closure.descendant_id WHERE child.deleted_at IS NULL AND child.status = 'ENABLED' ) SELECT root.id AS group_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN agent.id IS NOT NULL THEN member.agent_id END) AS member_count FROM fcc_agent_group root LEFT JOIN group_closure closure ON closure.ancestor_id = root.id LEFT JOIN fcc_agent_group_member member ON member.group_id = closure.descendant_id AND member.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN fcc_agent agent ON agent.id = member.agent_id AND agent.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE root.deleted_at IS NULL AND root.status = 'ENABLED' GROUP BY root.id
